limitations: Static engineering study and backlog adaptation only; no external implementation was run or copied.
All twelve capabilities are proposed, not implemented, scheduled or accepted for a sprint.
Existing thirty stories, sprint scopes/status/criteria, frozen eval inputs, runtime and defaults remain unchanged.
No new model calls, provider access, installation in target projects or remote writes beyond this repository workflow.
No performance, licensing clearance of external material, model efficacy or scientific validation is inferred from static inspection.
summary: Twelve proposed capabilities and forty-eight planned stages with canonical acceptance hashes. Covers functional examples, authority graph, stage context, attenuated delegation, workspace/resource isolation, CI receipts, environment readiness, asset intake, experience evals, shadow learning, flow dossiers and versioned knowledge. No sprint assignment or completion.
